name: Create a Grammar Atom for a New Catalog Class
summary: How to add a grammar atom to schema-atoms/atoms/ for a new catalog class, registering its structural contract in the ecosystem.

how_to_profile.task: Register a new catalog's structural contract in schema-atoms

body.inline:
## When to do this

Do this when you are creating a new *-atoms catalog and need to register its primary atom class in schema-atoms so it is discoverable and formally contracted.

## Steps

### 1. Name the grammar atom

Grammar atom IDs follow the convention `<catalog-name>-v<major>`. For example: `doc-atoms-v1`, `persona-atoms-v1`, `prompt-atoms-v1`.

### 2. Create the atom file

In a worktree on schema-atoms:

```bash
touch atoms/grammar/<catalog-name>-v1.json
```

### 3. Write the grammar atom JSON

```json
{
  "schema": "https://schema-atoms.com/schemas/atom-v1.json",
  "type": "grammar",
  "id": "<catalog-name>-v1",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "name": "<Catalog name> v1 atom grammar",
  "summary": "Structural contract for the <catalog name> primary atom class.",
  "audience": ["contributor", "developer"],
  "tags": ["<catalog-name>", "grammar", "schema"],
  "body": {
    "format": "markdown",
    "inline": "## Required fields\n\n| Field | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `schema` | string | Must be `https://<catalog-domain>/schemas/atom-v1.json` |\n| `type` | string | The atom type enum value |\n| `id` | string | Kebab-case identifier, unique within the catalog |\n| `version` | string | SemVer string |\n| `name` | string | Human-readable name |\n\n## Optional fields\n\n<List optional fields with their purpose>\n\n## Invariants\n\n<List the invariants that all atoms of this class must satisfy>"
  }
}
```

### 4. Validate and sign

```bash
python3 scripts/validate.py
node scripts/sign-atoms.mjs
```

### 5. Update schema-atoms catalog.json

Add your grammar atom to `exports/catalog.json` in schema-atoms.

### 6. Commit and open a PR against schema-atoms

```bash
git add atoms/grammar/<catalog-name>-v1.json keys/ exports/catalog.json
git commit -m "feat: add <catalog-name>-v1 grammar atom"
git push origin feat/<catalog-name>-grammar
gh pr create --repo convergent-systems-co/schema-atoms
```

## Notes

- The grammar atom PR on schema-atoms and the seed PR on your new catalog can be opened in parallel, but schema-atoms should merge first so the grammar reference is resolvable before the catalog deploys.
